newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian PTT to outline telecom restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Serbian PTT to outline telecom restructuring.

text.p: Telecommunications reform in Serbia will be a key issue at a three-day telecom forum, TELFOR '96, set to start November 26 in Belgrade, the Serbian PTT said on Wednesday.

"PTT's general manager Milorad Jaksic will present a more extensive outline of the sector's restructuring and we will reveal which country Serbia plans to take as a model for its... telecommunications (sector)," PTT spokeswoman Tanja Blecic told Reuters.
Experts will discuss aspects of mobile telephony, satellites and exchanges, she added.

The reform and privatisation of large state monopolies gained importance this year, when news leaked that the government was planning a partial privatisation of the PTT, and the power and oil industries.
